cards.subtitle: HanaMorph Modernization & Migration Suite

description.plain:
Card 1 — Use case & problem

Industry / user persona — Enterprise Data Architects, SAP BI Directors, Chief Data Officers (CDOs), and Financial Data Engineers across Global Enterprises (Manufacturing, Banking, Retail).

Problem (3 bullets) — • Monolithic CTE Lineage Collapse: Classical migration scripts collapse multi-tier calculation views into opaque, monolithic SQL WITH (CTE) statements, destroying intermediate node auditability and lineage in SAP Datasphere.
• Dependency & Import Failure Loops: Attribute naming mismatches (e.g. PARTNER vs PARTNR) and uncompiled calculated attributes trigger missing-object deployment crashes in Datasphere CSN import services.
• View Sprawl & Technical Debt: Legacy HANA environments carry 1,800+ calculation views with 80%+ duplicate pipelines on core tables (ACDOCA, BNKA), causing ballooning cloud compute costs.

What we solve (max 2 lines) — HanaMorph automates the live introspection, multi-tier visual DAG decomposition, and atomic CSN 2.0 compilation of complex Calculation Views, delivering 1:1 visual lineage parity in SAP Datasphere in under 5 minutes.

Tech stack tags (comma list) — SAP BTP Cloud Foundry, Node.js 20+, SAP Datasphere CSN 2.0, @sap/hana-client, SAP Fiori Horizon, Pure ANSI SQL-2016 Compiler, Kyma, REST APIs

SAP touchpoints (modules, tables, APIs) — SAP HANA Cloud, SAP HANA On-Premise (_SYS_BIC, BIMC_ALL_CUBES), SAP Datasphere Data Builder, Schema Import Services, ACDOCA, BKPF, BSEG, BNKA, BP001, BP1010

Image (optional) + caption — hanamorph_c1_1.png | Caption: Legacy SAP HANA Studio / Eclipse Calculation View DAG (CV_BANK) with 3-tier join hierarchy

Bot lines — • "Migrating multi-tier Calculation Views manually takes 3 to 5 days per view and usually destroys visual lineage."
• "Traditional tools combine all logic into an unreadable monolithic query that fails Datasphere's graphical editor."
• "HanaMorph parses the live calculation XML and reconstructs the full visual hierarchy automatically."
